array_method_mapping.kmeans: 4-cluster k-means on session features, per-cluster beta
array_method_mapping.feature_bucketed: 12 strata by length x memory-confidence, per-strata beta
array_method_mapping.oof_global: Single continuous beta optimized on OOF training data via pairwise reciprocal-rank loss (AdamW, beta_search=False)

cearfn_minilm_note: Same gate and memory expert as query_cond; only the neural expert's semantic teacher changes from TF-IDF to MiniLM. Gate parameters are NOT refit.
gate_equal_uses: query_cond vs equal_mixing arrays; gate parameters from the bounded 3-feature linear model trained on OOF data
gate_oof_uses: query_cond vs oof_global arrays; tests per-query allocation vs training-learned global policy
diginetica_caveat: The available Diginetica evaluation representation does not retain the original session identifier for expanded prefix queries; paired intervals resample at the recoverable query level.
